description.value: Town-run campground on Cowichan Lake — one of Vancouver Island's largest freshwater lakes — with easy paved access right in Lake Cowichan; tent sites run $44/night and the campground fills quickly, so advance reservations are essential.

address.value: 8815 Lakeview Park Road, Lake Cowichan, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at lakecowichan.ca/camping.php is the primary evidence source and confirms this is a municipally-operated campground at 8815 Lakeview Park Road, Lake Cowichan, operated by the Town of Lake Cowichan. The phone number on the website — (250)-737-3459 — matches the OSM record (+1-250-737-3459). The site explicitly confirms online reservations are accepted and that powered electrical sites (sites 2–30 and 35–38) are available; no hiker/biker-specific sites, showers, laundry, food, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the fetched content.
concerns: Website content was likely cached during the off-season: it states 'Lakeview Park campground is closed for the season' with reservations reopening March 9, 2026. As of May 2026 the campground should be open; the cached snapshot may not reflect current-season amenity details.
Address (8815 Lakeview Park Road) is absent from OSM but confirmed by website; address field populated from website.
Campground phone is noted on website as 'General inquiries only, from May long weekend to September long weekend', indicating seasonal phone availability only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, seasonally-operated municipal campground on Cowichan Lake with confirmed online reservations and powered sites; a useful and verifiable listing for touring cyclists travelling through the Cowichan Valley.
